title: session.telemetry params (AWP-TIM-006)
description: World-side latency measurements aggregated over the preceding window. Each quantity is present whenever at least one sample fell in the window.

observation_latency_ns.description: Pipeline latency, ts_send_ns − ts_mono_ns, over every observation frame sent in the window.

admission_latency_ns.description: Admission acknowledgement transmitted − received_ts_mono_ns, over every action.submit in the window.

observation_to_action_ns.description: received_ts_mono_ns − basis_ts_mono_ns, over every submission in the window that carried a basis.

command_latency_ns.description: World receipt − ts_mono_ns, over every command frame received in the window.

channels.description: Pipeline latency per observation channel, for every channel that sent frames in the window.
